specs.equipment_setup: Mat; forearms parallel at shoulder width, palms flat (or hands clasped for advanced).

phases.name: enter

names.tr: Duvar Omuz Açıcı (Duvarda Yarım Öne Katlanma)

names.tr: Destekli Köprü Pozu (Setu Bandha, blok ile)
names.en: Supported Bridge Pose (Setu Bandha Sarvangasana with block)

phases.name: enter

phases.name: hold
phases.description: Relax completely on the block, knees hip-width, chest lifted by gravity, arms palms-up or hands on belly; chin neutral.

phases.name: exit

Let the breath soften the belly

mistakes.visual: low back pinched with a sharp crease
mistakes.fix: slide block lower under the sacral plateau
strap around thighs or press inner feet down

specs.safety: Choose a block height that is comfortable; avoid with neck injury (keep neck neutral), or in late pregnancy lying flat for long. Come out slowly.
specs.regression: Use low block height or a bolster; place a folded blanket under shoulders.

mistakes.fix: gaze 30 cm ahead, lift chin slightly

phases.name: exit

start_pose.description: Standing forward fold, hands on floor.

phases.name: enter

phases.name: hold

phases.name: exit
phases.description: Lower leg slowly, step back to Uttanasana, then repeat other side.
